document: Critical User Journey: building on Claude Managed Agents (Anthropic cloud sandbox vs. GKE self-hosted sandbox)
persona: Developer with an existing Managed Agent, new to self-hosted sandboxes; macOS 14, Node 21, Python 3.13; GCP project golden-veld-361718

timing_sources.measured: Taken from system records: git commits, Anthropic resource/session created_at, GKE operations, Cloud Build, Cloud Run revisions, GCS/Secret Manager create times, Vercel deployment.
timing_sources.estimated: Inferred from neighbouring measured events; accurate to roughly +/- 3 minutes.

summary.total_wall_clock: ~2h20m (19:05 to 21:26), including design discussion and a security review

issues.title: Sessions silently did nothing: work items never acked
issues.detail: Raw work.poll without work.ack means EnvironmentWorker.handle_item has no lease and returns in under 1s with no error; the queue re-offers the item every 2 min. Logs showed phase=done with empty outputs. Google's sample has the same gap.
issues.detection: dispatcher logs + Cloud Logging + reading SDK _poller.py
issues.fix: ack after claiming a pod, before hand-off; stop the item if hand-off fails after ack

issues.title: Egress lockdown silently bypassed by Agent Sandbox defaults
issues.detail: Controller-managed NetworkPolicy allows 0.0.0.0/0 (policies are additive, overriding default-deny) and sets pod DNS to 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1, bypassing the cluster DNS that FQDNNetworkPolicy relies on. Sandboxes could reach example.com and storage.googleapis.com. The sample's FQDN policy never actually took effect.
issues.detection: manual in-sandbox egress test after first success
issues.fix: networkPolicyManagement: Unmanaged + dnsPolicy: ClusterFirst; added make verify-egress

issues.title: Pinned GKE version retired
issues.detail: Sample pins min_master_version 1.35.2-gke.1269000 -> 400 'Master version is unsupported'.

issues.title: Admission policy requires gVisor toleration
issues.detail: sandbox-core-policy rejects SandboxTemplate without toleration sandbox.gke.io/runtime=gvisor:NoSchedule; not in sample.

issues.title: Cloud Build 403 right after enabling the API
issues.detail: builds.create PERMISSION_DENIED for a project owner, ~30s after cloudbuild API enable; service agent not yet provisioned.

issues.title: Cloud Run reserves /healthz
issues.detail: Google Front End returns its own 404 for paths ending in 'z'.

issues.title: Makefile image tag drift
issues.detail: Recursively expanded $(shell date) produced different tags for build vs deploy.

issues.title: Environment key is Console-only; user created a second environment
issues.detail: Key generation exists only in Console; user created 'data-analysis-manual' and its key instead of keying the API-created environment. Keys are environment-scoped.

issues.title: Console quickstart command would run tools unsandboxed on a laptop
issues.detail: `ant beta:worker poll --workdir /workspace` pasted from Console runs agent bash directly on the host (and fails on macOS: /workspace not creatable).

issues.title: Tooling prerequisites
issues.detail: gcloud 480 < 565 required; beta component missing; ADC missing; gke-gcloud-auth-plugin missing; gh token expired.

issues.title: No file/GitHub resources or session outputs on self-hosted
issues.detail: Had to build metadata-based PDF staging and dispatcher-side output collection (+ reaper).

issues.title: workers_polling stayed 0 while dispatcher polled
issues.detail: Queue stats didn't reflect the raw-poll dispatcher.

issues.title: v1alpha1 deprecated; library pinned
issues.detail: k8s-agent-sandbox pinned to 0.4.6 (last v1alpha1-compatible); cluster serves v1beta1 as storage version.

issues.title: Add-on enablement takes ~13 min with no progress output
Secrets pasted into chat
issues.detail: API key and environment key shared in the conversation; rotation recommended.

cost_estimates_usd_per_month.notes: List prices; GKE free-tier credit ($74.40/mo per billing account) assumed to cover the Autopilot cluster fee; this is the only cluster on its billing account.

takeaways: The control-plane experience (agents, sessions, outcomes, budgets) was identical in both; all extra effort in CUJ-2 was infrastructure and data plumbing.

The two critical CUJ-2 issues (no ack; egress bypass) both came from following the reference sample, and neither raised an error: sessions 'completed' empty, and the network looked locked down but wasn't.
~22 of ~101 minutes to first success were waiting on GKE (cluster 8m43s + add-on 12m43s).
Console-only environment key generation was the main point where the user got confused.
Self-hosted lacks file/GitHub resources, Files API outputs, and vault env-var credentials, so the app had to build staging and collection itself.
